title: beNNch: modular and continuous benchmarking of neuronal network simulations
description: beNNch is a modular framework for performance benchmarking of neuronal network simulations. Version 1.x provides a workflow for reproducible, comparable benchmarks of simulation engines such as NEST. Version 2.0 ("CI-beNNch") restructures the framework around continuous benchmarking: it takes a declarative benchmark configuration from a researcher, generates a GitLab CI pipeline from it, and executes the resulting benchmark jobs autonomously on HPC systems.
